title: Treat yourself to some me time!
text: Love love love this box!! Amazing scents and a great new book that I haven’t read yet! Working as a full time nurse during a pandemic has been stressful! I’m going to love my “me time” this weekend. I originally subbed to the 1 book box but it was so great I upped my subscription to the 2 book box! Can’t wait for the next shipment!
label: positive
